profile_text.body:
Character.AI, founded in 2022, operates an AI chat platform where users can converse with AI characters. The company describes itself as offering "AI Chat, Reimagined" and positions its service as "the #1 AI chat app," inviting users to "chat with millions of AI Characters."

The company's main product is Character.ai, a persona-based chat application built on large language models. The product carries noted human-review concerns around HR and appropriate-use considerations, reflecting the risks inherent in interactive AI chat systems that simulate distinct personalities.
